title: Apple's New Leasing Options for iPhones and Macs
description: Apple has announced plans to offer leasing options for iPhones and Macs, starting at $17.99 a month, in partnership with Klarna.

sources.title: Apple plans to lease iPhones for $17.99 a month through partnership with Klarna
Apple Upgrade launches in the United States
Apple will now let you lease your next iPhone or Mac instead of buying it

sections.heading: Apple's Leasing Program
paragraphs: Apple has introduced a new leasing program, allowing customers to lease iPhones and Macs instead of purchasing them outright. This initiative is in collaboration with Klarna and is currently available in the United States.

sections.heading: Leasing Details
paragraphs: According to CNBC, the leasing program starts at $17.99 a month for iPhones. This move is seen as an alternative to traditional purchasing, providing customers with more flexibility in accessing Apple's products.

sections.heading: Apple Upgrade
paragraphs: Apple has also launched 'Apple Upgrade' in the United States, which is part of their broader initiative to offer more flexible options to customers. This program allows users to lease their next iPhone or Mac and includes AppleCare+ for additional protection.

faq.q: What is Apple's new leasing program?
faq.a: Apple's new leasing program, in partnership with Klarna, allows customers to lease iPhones and Macs starting at $17.99 a month, offering an alternative to buying these products outright.

faq.q: Is the leasing program available in the United States?
faq.a: Yes, according to Apple, the leasing program and 'Apple Upgrade' are both available in the United States, providing customers with more options to access iPhones and Macs.
